title: Housing Subsidy - Citizen Top-Up
description: Provides a $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a family member becomes a Singapore Citizen.
highlights: $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a household member acquires Singapore citizenship
Citizen Top-Up  is credited into CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
Can be used for repayment or redemption of housing loan, future HDB flat purchase or CPF withdrawal at age 55

sections.About this support:
- $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible households when a qualifying member becomes a Singapore Citizen
- The subsidy is converted into equal shares and credited fully into the CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
- Only core flat owners can use their share of the CPF housing grants to pay for the flat e.g. loan repayment
- The Citizen Top-Up can be used for a lump sum repayment or full redemption of an HDB housing loan
- For housing loans from financial institutions, you may additionally use it for monthly instalments
  - You must clear all outstanding housing loan arrears before you can use the grant for the above purposes
- If you have any remaining Citizen Top-Up balance and no housing loan, you may use it to buy another HDB flat in the future, or to form part of the CPF funds available for withdrawal under CPF rules at age 55
sections.Who is this for?:
- Households that have paid a $10,000 premium when buying a flat from HDB
- Households who received a reduced Family Grant for a resale flat, a Design Build and Sell Scheme flat or an Executive Condominium unit
- The Citizen Top-Up is granted when a Permanent Resident spouse, parent, child or sibling^ originally listed in the flat application obtains Singapore Citizenship, or when a Singapore Citizen child is born to the Singapore Citizen applicant and spouse originally listed in the flat application

^ For siblings, this qualification only applies to flats purchased as orphaned siblings or for families with a non-resident spouse.
sections.How to apply?:
Submit your application online:

- Use the [Application for Citizen Top-up e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg//webapp/AB22AWTopUpGrantWeb/AB22PMain#) within 6 months of meeting the citizenship criteria

title: Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP)
description: Eligible applicants can remain in Singapore for an extended period via a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP).

sections.About this support:
- Eligible foreigners can stay in Singapore for an extended period of time
- The LTVP will be issued digitally and can be viewed on the Singpass app or downloaded from [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip) or via [FileSG](https://www.file.gov.sg/for-individuals)
- Singapore Citizens with foreign spouses may also be eligible for LTVP Plus (LTVP+), providing a longer period of residency and additional employment and healthcare benefits
sections.Who is this for?:
The following applicant types are eligible to apply for LTVP:

- Spouse of a Singapore citizen (must be sponsored by the Singapore citizen spouse)^
- Foreign spouse of a Singapore Permanent Resident (must be sponsored by the Permanent Resident spouse)
- Unmarried child under 21, born within a legal marriage to / legally adopted by a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident (must be sponsored by parents)
- Parent of a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident (sponsor must be above 21)
- Graduate from an Institute of Higher Learning seeking employment in Singapore
- Parent or grandparent of a Student’s Pass holder studying in Singapore (requires a local sponsor above 21 years old)
- Visitor seeking to give birth in Singapore (requires a local sponsor above 21 years old)

Please note that all the above criteria are not exhaustive. Eligibility is still subject to ICA’s final approval.

- Singapore Citizens with foreign spouses may also be eligible for LTVP Plus (LTVP+), providing a longer period of residency and additional employment and healthcare benefits
- For more information on the [LTVP+ and its benefits, as well as your eligibility for it, please refer here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/news-and-publications/newsroom/media-release/351)

For LTVP+

- No separate application is required. You will automatically be considered for LTVP+ (if eligible) when you apply for LTVP

^ Couples consisting of a Singapore Citizen and a Non-Resident are strongly encouraged to complete their Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment (PMLA) before marriage. [Learn more about the PMLA here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/pre-marriage-long-term-visit-pass-assessment) and [apply for PMLA here](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evpaa).
sections.How to apply?:
- Submit your application online using the [e-Service](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evp)
- After receiving the in-principle approval notice for your LTVP application, refer to the [various procedures relating to the Completion of Formalities and the Issuance of Long-Term Visit Pass ](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/LTVP/cof-and-issue-new)for the next steps
- For further assistance, please contact ICA at [6391 6100](tel:6391-6100) or [submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/ica-ltvp-enquiry)
sections.What to expect?:
- A S$45 non-refundable processing fee is applicable for each application
- Additional fees will apply if the LTVP application is granted in-principle approval
- Applications are generally processed within six weeks, provided all required documents are submitted and in order
- It may take longer for couples who did not complete the PMLA (up to 6 months)
- You will be informed of the application outcome via email and may also check the application status online through [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip) or the [e-Service](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evp)

title: Permanent Residency
description: Allows eligible foreigners to apply for permanent residency.

sections.About this support:
- Facilitates the process for eligible foreigners to reside in Singapore on a permanent basis
- Permanent Residents aged 15 and above will be issued the Singapore blue Identity Card (IC)
sections.Who is this for?:
Available for:

- Spouse of a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Unmarried child (aged below 21) born from a legal marriage to / have been legally adopted by a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Aged parent of a Singapore Citizen
- Employment Pass or S Pass holder
- Student studying in Singapore
- Foreign investor in Singapore

Please note that the above criteria are not exhaustive. Individual eligibility is still subject to ICA’s approval.
sections.How to apply?:
- Refer to [ICA's explanatory notes](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/PR/apply) and prepare the required supporting documents
- All permanent residence applications must be submitted online using the [e-Service ](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/epr)using your valid Singpass account, or your Foreign Identification Number and immigration pass issuance date if you're a student
- For more information on e-Service accessibility, please refer to the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://ask.gov.sg/ica) and [Step-by-Step guide](https://www.ica.gov.sg/docs/default-source/ica/eservices/epr/step-by-step-guide.pdf) in the e-Service
- For further assistance, please contact ICA at [6391 6100](tel:6391-6100) or [submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/ica-pr-enquiry)
sections.What to expect?:
- Processing time for each application is at least 6 months
- You may check your application status online through [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip)
- A $100 non-refundable processing fee is payable for each applicant at the point of submission of application
- If application is successful, you will need to complete permanent residency formalities personally at the ICA office

title: National Service LifeSG Credits
description: $200 in LifeSG credits for all eligible past and present national servicemen to recognise their contributions to Singapore’s defence and security.
highlights: For all eligible past and present national servicemen
Credits have been automatically disbursed to eligible national servicemen in 2024
Valid for 1 year from the date of disbursement

sections.About this support:
- $200 in LifeSG credits for all eligible past and present national servicemen, accessible via the ‘Your Benefits’ section of the [LifeSG mobile application](https://go.life.gov.sg/5yCp).
- The credits are valid for 1 year from the date of disbursement. The validity period will not be extended.
- Eligible national servicemen may check on the validity period of their credits through the LifeSG mobile application.

**Where to use the NS LifeSG Credits:**

- The credits can be spent at online or physical merchants accepting payments via PayNow UEN QR or NETS QR.
- As a show of support for National Service, several merchants are offering additional discounts and promotions when payments are made using the NS LifeSG Credits. For the list of participating merchants, please refer [here.](https://go.gov.sg/promosnslifesg)
sections.Who is this for?:
- Full-Time National Servicemen (NSFs) who have enlisted by 31 Dec 2024.
- Past and present Operationally Ready National Servicemen (NSmen).
- Disbursements are subject to further eligibility checks.
- Eligible national servicemen were notified by SMS and letter in 2024.
sections.How to apply?:
- No application required.
- The credits have been automatically disbursed via the LifeSG mobile application to eligible past and present national servicemen in 2024.
- An SMS notification and notification letter were sent to eligible national servicemen after the credits were disbursed.
sections.Where to go: Walk in to any [SG Digital Community Hub](http://go.gov.sg/sdch-nslifesgcredits2024) or [ServiceSG Centre](https://www.psd.gov.sg/servicesg/) if you face difficulty in redeeming your credits.
sections.Agency website:
- Refer [here](https://go.gov.sg/faqnslifesg) for Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs).
- View [step-by-step guide](https://www.wallet.gov.sg/how-to-use) on how to use the credits.
sections.Email / Form: For technical assistance on the LifeSG mobile application, please contact [helpdesk@life.gov.sg](mailto:helpdesk@life.gov.sg).
sections.Phone number:
- Those who are unable to access the credits digitally may request hardcopy vouchers.
- For hardcopy vouchers, or for other enquiries, please contact the NS Call Centre at [1800 367 6767](tel:18003676767) or [contact@ns.gov.sg](mailto:contact@ns.gov.sg).

title: NSman Relief
description: Provides tax relief to eligible operationally ready National Servicemen (NSmen) to recognise their contributions to National Service, as well as to the wives and parents of NSmen to recognise the support they give to their husbands or sons.
highlights: Tax relief provided for NSmen and their wives and parents

sections.About this support:
- NSman Self Relief of $1,500 to $5,000 for eligible NSmen
- NSman Wife Relief of $750 for the wives of eligible NSmen
- NSman Parent Relief of $750 for each parent of the eligible NSman
sections.Who is this for?:
**NSman Self Relief:**

- Completed full-time National Service under the Enlistment Act or deemed to have completed such service by the proper authority
- Not a regular in the following organisations:
  - MINDEF
  - Singapore Police Force
  - Singapore Civil Defence Force
  - Central Narcotics Bureau
  - Singapore Prison Service
- Have not committed disciplinary or criminal offences in the preceding work year
- If you and your son are both NSmen, you will be eligible for either the NSman Self Relief or NSman Parent Relief, whichever is higher

**NSman Wife Relief:**

- You are a Singapore Citizen in the previous year
- Your husband is eligible for Nsman Self Relief
- Widows of deceased NSmen may also be eligible unless they have re-married

**NSman Parent Relief:**

- You are a Singapore Citizen in the previous year
- Your child is eligible for NSman Self Relief
- Your child was born to you and your spouse or ex-spouse / is your step-child / was legally adopted
- Parents of deceased NSmen are also eligible
- If you and your son are both NSmen, you will be eligible for either the NSman Self Relief or NSman Parent Relief, whichever is higher
- The relief amount per parent is capped at $750, regardless of how many children are NSmen
sections.How to apply?: No application is required. The relief will be automatically granted based on eligibility.
